Class Tile

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.galaxy_trucker.server.model.tiles.Tile
Direct Known Subclasses:
ActivatableTile, AlienSupportTile, BatteriesTile, CabinTile, CargoTile, EmptyTile, ShieldTile, StructuralTile
public abstract class Tile extends Object
Abstract class representing a tile in the game. Each tile has a fixed ID, an array of four Connectors representing connections on its sides (in default orientation), and a current rotation state.

The actual connector logic under rotation is handled here; visual rotation is done in JavaFX.

      public Tile(int id, Connector[] connectors)
      Constructs a tile with the given ID and connectors.
      Parameters:
      id - the unique identifier of the tile

      public int getRotation()
      Returns the current rotation state of the tile. Values are 0 (0°), 1 (90°), 2 (180°), 3 (270°).
      Returns:
      the rotation of the tile

    • setRotation

      public void setRotation(int rotation)
      Sets the rotation of the tile. Rotation must be between 0 and 3 (inclusive).
      Parameters:
      rotation - the new rotation value (0–3)
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if rotation is outside the allowed range

      public Connector[] getConnectors()

    • getConnector

      public Connector getConnector(int side)
      Returns the connector currently facing the given side after accounting for rotation. The side index follows this order: 0 = top, 1 = right, 2 = bottom, 3 = left.
      Parameters:
      side - the side to query (0–3)
      Returns:
      the connector at that side after rotation
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if side is not in the range 0–3
